integrity: Exact finite face enumeration, checked acyclic discrete Morse matching, integer unit cancellations and direct mod-two cross-check; all checker source embedded and reproducible without external packages.
scientific_limitations: Only the 6-vertex bidirected octahedron is treated; no all-parameter, cup-product, group-action or integral homotopy type is asserted. A general top-degree theorem independently supplies the degree-four rank; the lower integral groups and no-torsion calculation are the central contribution.
title: Integral multipath homology of the bidirected octahedral graph
